[[File:Theresa Buchheister.png|thumb|Theresa Buchheister]] '''Theresa Buchheister''' is a non-binary voice actor and former voice director for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} by [[DuArt Film & Video]]. They joined the series in 2015, succeeding the previous voice director, [[Tom Wayland]]. They left DuArt in January 2016, and was succeeded as voice director by [[Lisa Ortiz]]. ==Pokémon roles== ===Animation=== ===={{aniseries|PTS}}==== * [[Aliana]] ==External links== {{bulbanews|Theresa Buchheister departs as English dub voice director}} * [https://www.linkedin.com/pub/theresa-buchheister/3/553/b26 LinkedIn profile] * [https://dailygeekette.wordpress.com/2015/08/25/the-daily-geekette-interviews-theresa-buchheister/ Interview with Theresa Buchheister] {{stub|Anime}}
